Definition
[Quasi-isometric vector field] \group extensions Source: thurston:page-0307

A vector field is $k$-quasi-isometric if its flow $\varphi _t$ satisfies \[ e^{-kt}d(x,y)\le d(\varphi _t(x),\varphi _t(y))\le e^{kt}d(x,y). \]
